progression.narrative: The performance opens on B4 and dwells most on B in Nahib. Eraq (0:26.3) introduces Gb, centred on Gb. Kereshme (1:07.1) introduces Eb, E, Ab, Bb, centred on Gb. The line peaks at Ab4 (401.3 Hz) at 1:10.8. It closes on the tonic (Gb4 → Gb4 → Eb4 → B3 → Bb3 → B2).
